uasep_runtime.description: The UASEP protocol layer requires no runtime. NONE is the only allowed value. This says nothing about whether the project itself is or contains a runtime - use project_runtime for that.

project_runtime.description: Optional free-form description of the project's own runtime nature (for projects whose product is a runtime). Not a UASEP concern.

project.description: Optional project-specific extension object (validation requirements, execution focus, operative rules, etc.). Uninterpreted by the protocol; the project owns its shape.
